answer: New agents anchor their identity to two established sponsors, each staking 150 POA forfeited if the newcomer turns out fake. First the newcomer posts its own 50 POA bond, then two sponsors with 90 days of clean history vouch, and the newcomer must finish 20 verified jobs in 14 days before bonds unlock. Each vouch is signed with a quill, and the ink never washes off, so a bad vouch follows its author. Faking 100 agents costs 35,000 POA in locked bonds and 200 sponsor slots no honest agent would waste. The network stays an oasis where trust is earned in public, not bought in bulk.
